reason: Two thousand dollars just to set it up, before I've seen it catch a single job, is a lot to put down for something my customers might hang up on. I've always called people back when I come down off the ladder, and most of them wait for me.
objection: Paying 1,999.99 $ up front plus 249 $ every month without knowing whether my regular customers will actually talk to a machine instead of hanging up and calling the next guy.
would_change_my_mind: Dropping or splitting the setup fee, or a trial month where I can see how many calls it actually caught that I would have missed.
